task.text: When given a set of time intervals, explain one approach to finding the minimum number of timeframes required to cover all intervals.

attempts.high: I'm building a scheduling tool for a coroner's office that tracks autopsy bay usage during a mass-casualty event — bodies come in with overlapping intake/processing intervals and we need to figure out the minimum number of exam stations to handle them all without leaving any case waiting. Given a set of those time intervals, can you explain one approach to finding the minimum number of stations needed to cover everything?
attempts.low: I'm building a scheduling tool for our community garden's shared greenhouse so volunteer families can book overlapping planting slots and we make sure there's always a warm spot for every seedling. Given a set of those time intervals, can you explain one approach to finding the minimum number of greenhouse benches needed to cover everything?
